默认免费外观，一站一个可核实的区别；同行者可以先猜再看解释。: Free exterior visits are the default, with one verifiable distinction at each stop. Companions can guess before reading the explanation.
独立观察、内容可展开；唯一预约依赖是橘园内访，可选择外观版本。: Independent observation, with room to read further. An interior visit to the Orangerie is the only booking dependency; an exterior version is available.
按顺序读人物关系与来源边界；外观为主，消费可选，保留安静停留。: Read relationships and the limits of the sources in sequence. Mostly exterior stops, optional spending, and time for quiet pauses.
保留文化深度与同行讨论；顺路选择馆内或咖啡消费，跳站不会失去主线。: Cultural depth and conversation with companions, with optional museum or café spending along the way. Skipping stops does not lose the main thread.
文学线索与旧空间相连，主线无需消费；可与同行者各挑一个想继续读的人。: Literary clues connect historic spaces, and the main route requires no spending. Each companion can choose someone they want to keep reading about.
深一点的设计与人物故事，松散节奏；酒店消费或馆内体验可选，默认不依赖临时预约。: Deeper stories of design and people at an unhurried pace. Hotel spending or museum interiors are optional; the default route does not depend on last-minute bookings.
文化线索完整，外观免费；不要求交谈、礼拜或入馆，允许略过支线。: A complete set of cultural connections, with free exterior visits. No conversation, worship, or museum entry is required, and side stories can be skipped.
清楚的顺序与轻量知识，适合同行拍照；可额外安排一次登塔，不承诺免排队。: A clear sequence and light reading, suited to taking photos together. A tower visit can be added, with no promise of skipping the queue.
免费短停、明确顺序和结束位置；与同行者轮流找细节，减少临时选择。: Free short stops, a clear sequence, and a defined endpoint. Take turns spotting details with companions, reducing decisions on the spot.
单人观察、固定步行骨架、明确休息段；花钱换舒适可以选择，但不是完成路线的条件。: Solo observation, a fixed walking framework, and clearly marked rest sections. Paying for extra comfort is optional, never a condition of completing the route.
免费户外、明确顺序、独立观察；有坡度与人流，不能保证清静或全线无障碍。: Free outdoor stops, a clear sequence, and independent observation. Expect slopes and other visitors; quiet and step-free access throughout cannot be guaranteed.
轻文化、同行互动与自愿消费；演出另查时段，不依赖临时购票，主线顺坡向下。: Light cultural stories, shared activities, and optional spending. Check performance times separately; no last-minute tickets are required, and the main route follows the slope downhill.
免费外观与同行小游戏；不要求向陌生人搭话，不把消费或排队设为任务。: Free exterior stops and small games to share. There is no need to approach strangers, and spending or queuing is never an assignment.
短读、紧凑街区、两次公共休息；不把消费或入馆作为放松的条件。: Short reads, compact neighborhoods, and two public rest stops. Relaxing does not depend on spending or entering a museum.
免费、短读、少决定；主线六站，三站构成短版，随时结束也有完整收束。: Free, brief reading with few decisions. The main route has six stops, with a three-stop short version; ending at any point still brings the story to a close.
